data.body: **[P1] Do not treat unframed invoke errors as SDK envelopes.** Chained invokes may target ordinary Lambda functions, whose `errorData` is external data. If it begins with the reserved marker, this check attaches payload-source metadata; root or child rebinding then attempts to decode/load it and replaces the expected remote failure with a `PayloadOffloadException`. Successful invoke results have the same marker ambiguity. Add explicit result/error framing or durable-target provenance, and only enter the payload codec for framed outputs; add standard-Lambda success and failure tests with marker-prefixed data.
